def check_layout(starts, hops, nodes):$
    """Legal-tree agreement with the canonical runs of one version."""$
    size = len(starts)$
    if size < 1 or size > fib.MAX_RUNS or not nodes or len(nodes) > 2 * size - 1:$
        return False$
    if nodes[0]["lo"] != 0 or nodes[0]["span"] != size:$
        return False$
    ends = [n["lo"] + n["span"] for n in nodes]$
    order, queue = [], [0]$
    while queue:$
        index = queue.pop(0)$
        order.append(index)$
        node = nodes[index]$
        if not layout.legal(node, starts):$
            return False$
        children = node["children"]$
        if children:$
            if len(children) < 2 or len(children) > 9 or len(children) > node["span"]:$
                return False$
            cursor = node["lo"]$
            for child in children:$
                if not index < child < len(nodes) or child in order:$
                    return False$
                if nodes[child]["lo"] != cursor or ends[child] > ends[index]:$
                    return False$
                cursor = ends[child]$
            if cursor != ends[index]:$
                return False$
        elif node["span"] > 8:$
            return False$
        order.extend(children)$
    if order != list(range(len(nodes))):$
        return False$
    return True$
